card-two-piece.alt: The two-piece Classic Dark card taken apart, back up: the back piece lifted off, the round NFC sticker, and the front piece, a shallow tray with the sticker's pocket. The back piece presses in and snaps past a lip on the rim; glued, it's permanent. The black is drawn lighter here so the shapes show.

The pieces swap, so one box shows many combinations.
